DESCRIPTION_EN: An original adult woman laboratory field assistant and practical mechanic for a 1940s science-adventure team. Human proportions, short chestnut bobbed hair held back with a simple ivory headband, friendly determined original face. She wears a rolled-sleeve ivory work blouse under deep navy bib overalls with broad shoulder straps and plain brown lace-up work boots. A single substantial steel open-ended wrench is held low in her RIGHT hand, fully clear of the thigh, while her LEFT hand is empty and relaxed. No lab coat, no dress, no ray gun, no extra tools, no tool belt and no actor likeness.
ANCHORS_EN: single steel wrench held low in the RIGHT hand; navy bib overalls; rolled ivory blouse sleeves; short chestnut bob and simple ivory headband; work boots
NOTES: Original technician interpretation of Daisy's companion role with Jill Trent's gadgetology. The source confirms identity and mechanics, not this costume or wrench. Distinct from Jill's existing coat/dress/raygun design. No rig/model/game-readiness claim; future stage-0 registration and independent design acceptance required.
